summary: Sigma Lithium filed a 6-K announcing the pricing of a upsized US$125 million senior unsecured convertible bond due 2031, offered solely outside Canada and the US under Regulation S; the deal was upsized 25% from US$100 million and priced at a 7.00% fixed coupon with a 25% conversion premium over the US$5.21 Nasdaq close on November 2, 2026, implying a US$6.51 conversion price. Net proceeds fully refinance the Synergy Capital senior secured debt maturing June 2027, cutting short-term debt roughly 80% and releasing security.
